result.instructions: One read-only tool: score_posting. It reads stored postings only.

tools.name: score_posting
tools.title: Score one stored job posting
tools.description: Read-only. Returns the JS3 filter (FILTER.md v0.3) decision for ONE job posting already saved on disk: outcome (accept/reject/flag/abstain), the deciding rule, and four claims (title, authorization, seniority, skills) each labelled supported/contradicted/insufficient with an exact quote. No network access. The only write is the server's own message log in its transcripts/ folder; it changes no posting, file or account. The decision is evidence, not advice to apply.

board.description: board slug, e.g. openai, cloudflare, zoox

posting_id.description: the posting id as stored by the board
